vectors.name: tcr_guard
vectors.note: system coll 60 WETH against 95,000 debt. At 1600 the TCR is 1.0105 < CRITICAL_TCR, so the redemption reverts TCRBelowCritical even though carol (ICR 320%) would be redeemable; at 1700 the TCR is 1.0737, between CRITICAL_TCR and MCR, and the same redemption goes through on carol (alice, ICR 94.4%, is skipped below MCR) (spec 6.7.2)

inputs.notes: weth deltas in expected are relative to actorWeth

vectors.name: partial_cancelled_below_mcr
vectors.note: price = MIN_PRICE start value (10 WAD), index 1.2304 after 4.25 years. alice (the tail) sits exactly at MCR with zero slack. An 11-wei redemption would cancel 8 wei of normalised debt (mulDivDown) for 1 wei of collateral, and the remaining debt rounds up, so without the post-check her ICR would end below MCR. The post-check cancels the partial with no state change, nothing is redeemed -> NothingRedeemed. A 1,000-stable redemption of the same position is an ordinary partial: it raises her ICR and goes through (spec 6.7.3, CHG-002)
